text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(I will reach it. —I will reach it! 
For our long-cherished dream. For my own 
sake!)

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
...She can do it. She can do it...! 
At this pace... K-Keep going, gooooooo!!!

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Go for itttt! Take the leaaad!! 
Phalaeno-saaaan!!
choice_data_list: Reach ittttttt!!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *gasp*... *pant*, *pant*...!! 
Yes... Everyone is counting on me...!!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Therefore—step aside. 
Not a single soul shall touch it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: That crown belongs to me!!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
It's Phalaenopsisssss! 
A brilliant, decisive victory for 
Phalaenopsis!

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff B
text_block_list.text:
...! She did it...! 
A champion from our club, truly...!!

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
U-Uwaah... Phalaeno-san... 
She did it... She actually did it...!

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Aah!! We finally have one! 
Our club's very first...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, but of course.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Are you watching, Trainer? 
Are you watching, my comrades of the club?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...It has been a long road. 
Yet all of you kept the thread unbroken 
through every passing day.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
From the days when I was a child, unto 
this very moment. 
You forged this future. Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I have claimed it.

text_block_list.name: Club Members
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations...!" "Congratulations!" 
"Waaah! She did it!" "Phalaeno-san!" 
"Uuu... My tears are blurring 
everything...!!!"
choice_data_list: Congratulations...! Truly...!!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: For now, I have lived up to their hopes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the race, everyone gathers to 
welcome back Phalaenopsis, 
who brought the club its very first GⅠ 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Club Members
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you...!" "Thank you so much!" 
"Thank you, Phalaeno-san...!" 
"Thank you for winning!" "Thank you!!"

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. The pleasure is mine. 
It is all thanks to everyone who placed 
their faith in me.

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Gosh... This is just too much to handle! 
Because I know how hard you've worked, 
Phalaeno-san... *sniffle*...!
choice_data_list: (...I'm so glad. Truly...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My own contribution was modest at best, 
but seeing 
everyone from the club shower Phalaenopsis 
with gratitude, 
I felt that sentiment from the bottom of 
my heart.

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Oh, that reminds me! We're 
having a party 
to celebrate Phalaeno-san sometime soon, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's all ready! It was originally 
planned 
to celebrate running in a Classic race, 
but... 
we'll have to rename it a 'Victory 
Celebration' now!

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
All right, things are about to get busy!! 
We'll let you 
know the date at a later time, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Yes, absolutely!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, 
the day of the victory celebration 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
……Incredible. To think they would prepare 
such an extravagant celebration for us.
choice_data_list:
Yeah! You can really feel everyone's 
excitement!

Yeah! You can really feel how thrilled 
everyone is!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
……Hmm. It is but one crown, a single 
blossom. 
I merely brought back the cherry blossoms 
that rightfully belong to our club.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
So to receive such lavish praise…… 
is, admittedly, a bit embarrassing, but—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
……Goodness. Look, Trainer. 
There are phalaenopsis orchids not just at 
the entrance, but filling the hall as 
well.
choice_data_list: You're right! They're everywhere……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Throughout this celebration, gorgeous 
phalaenopsis orchids 
were displayed everywhere, in breathtaking 
abundance.
choice_data_list:
The folks at the club must have arranged 
all of this.

The club members must have prepared all 
this for us.

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, it wasn't just us! 
So many were sent to the club as 
congratulatory gifts!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: My goodness, is that so……?!

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Many racing associates connected to 
our club 
sent them over to celebrate your triumph!

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, our offices were practically 
overflowing! 
So—I'm truly glad we had the chance to put 
them 
on display where everyone could admire 
them!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ……That is a true blessing.
choice_data_list:
I think everyone just couldn't help but 
celebrate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a testament to the virtues of the 
club and Phalaenopsis herself, 
as well as proof of just how prestigious 
a crown like the Oka Sho truly is.
choice_data_list:
That's just how incredible your 
accomplishment was.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her resolute focus kept her from getting 
carried away 
by a single victory, so I wanted to 
reassure her: 
she was more than allowed to take pride in 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
…………Heh. I see. 
...That much, then……

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To be overly modest would border on 
discourtesy. 
—I shall take pride in it, as is fitting.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Once again, for arranging such a wonderful 
gathering, 
I thank you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To see so many of you celebrating with us 
brings me greater joy than anything else.

text_block_list.name: Male Club Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe…… We're delighted to hear that! 
Now then, would you do us the honor 
of giving the toast?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, I thank you from the bottom of 
my heart 
for taking the time to gather here today 
on my behalf.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Our club, and my Trainer— 
have seized an honor worthy of such a 
gathering.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—However, I have no intention whatsoever 
of stopping here.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
This is merely the beginning. 
The very first step toward our club's true 
prosperity.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
……That said, today let us celebrate and 
make merry. 
For we have conquered our very first 
trial.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: To our beautiful garden—cheers.

text_block_list.name: Attendees
text_block_list.text: Cheers—!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: …………Fufu.
choice_data_list: Oh, someone's in high spirits!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Once again, Trainer. 
—Well done.
choice_data_list:
Right back at you. I always knew you'd 
pull it off.

You too. I always knew you would achieve 
it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was simply stating a fact. Because 
I had seen Phalaenopsis exceed every 
expectation 
placed upon her time and time again—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa…… One more lap!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Actions, not words—through her quiet 
dedication, 
she grew precisely as I, her Trainer, had 
hoped. 
She never once betrayed the admiration I 
held for her as her disciple.
choice_data_list:
You're an umamusume worth giving my all 
for.

You're an umamusume worthy of everything I 
have to give.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: …………Haha.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
That brings me greater pleasure than any 
compliment I received today.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Now then, that is quite enough letting 
our guard down. 
It is high time to tighten our helmet 
strings once more.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. The next race is the 
Oaks... 
Do you have your sights set on it?
choice_data_list: Yeah. I've already prepared a proposal.
Yep. I've already prepared a proposal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The hurdle facing any Umamusume chasing 
the Triple Tiara 
is this... the sudden jump in distance 
when moving 
from the Oka Sho to challenge the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho is run over 1,600 meters of 
turf. 
In contrast, the Oaks is 2,400 meters— 
a full 800 meters longer.
choice_data_list: Naturally, stamina will be essential.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She must avoid exhausting herself along 
the way, conserving 
enough in her legs for the moment she 
enters that long final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For that reason, stamina training is 
essential. 
Furthermore, we wanted her to master pace 
control, so we needed 
to find a partner capable of matching her 
in training.
choice_data_list:
I'm still thinking about who that partner 
should be, though.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. 
In that case, how about Hayahide?
choice_data_list: I see! That's a great idea!
I see! That sounds wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide. A winner of three G1 
titles, and 
above all, renowned for her unwavering 
consistency at 
the top of the pack. She is Narita Brian's 
elder sister.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Adept in logical thinking, she constantly 
hones herself 
by formulating a "formula for victory." 
And as a result of building up her 
stamina—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She won both the Kikuka Sho and the Tenno 
Sho (Spring). 
Though she has stepped back from the front 
lines, 
her prowess at long distances is 
indisputable.
choice_data_list:
If she's willing to help, she'd be the 
perfect choice.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Then allow me to ask her. 
After all, she is an old acquaintance of 
mine.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Certainly, I don't mind at all. 
If I will suffice, I would be glad to 
help.
choice_data_list: Thank you! That's a huge help.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it... It is Phaleno-kun 
and me, after all. 
Besides, I find myself personally 
intrigued by you as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Once again, I look forward to working with 
you. 
Phaleno-kun. Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our next race is the Oaks. After building 
stamina 
together with Biwa Hayahide, we will aim 
for victory.
